policy:approval_decisions:read_decisions.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.approval_rounds r
  WHERE (r.id = approval_decisions.round_id)))

policy:approval_participants:read_partic.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.approval_rounds r
  WHERE (r.id = approval_participants.round_id)))

policy:artwork_versions:production_versi.using:
((public.actor_role() = 'production'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.production_packages pp
  WHERE (pp.version_id = artwork_versions.id))))

policy:artwork_versions:staff_version_re.using:
((public.actor_role() = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'manager'::text, 'designer'::text, 'prepress'::text])) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.artworks a
  WHERE ((a.id = artwork_versions.artwork_id) AND public.can_project(a.project_id)))))

policy:artworks:production_artwork.using:
((public.actor_role() = 'production'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.production_packages pp
  WHERE (pp.artwork_id = artworks.id))))

policy:brief_versions:read_briefs.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.artworks a
  WHERE ((a.id = brief_versions.artwork_id) AND public.can_project(a.project_id))))

policy:comment_resolution_links:read_res.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.comment_threads t
  WHERE (t.id = comment_resolution_links.thread_id)))

policy:comments:read_comments.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.comment_threads t
  WHERE (t.id = comments.thread_id)))

policy:file_previews:read_previews.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.version_files f
  WHERE (f.id = file_previews.file_id)))

policy:organizations:production_org.using:
((public.actor_role() = 'production'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (public.projects p
     JOIN public.production_packages pp ON ((pp.project_id = p.id)))
  WHERE (p.organization_id = organizations.id))))

policy:organizations:read_org.using:
((public.actor_role() = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'manager'::text, 'designer'::text, 'prepress'::text])) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.organization_memberships m
  WHERE ((m.organization_id = organizations.id) AND (m.user_id = public.actor_id())))))

policy:profiles:project_profile_names.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.project_members m
  WHERE ((m.user_id = profiles.id) AND public.can_project(m.project_id))))

policy:profiles:read_profiles.using:
((id = public.actor_id()) OR (public.actor_role() = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'manager'::text])) OR ((public.actor_role() = ANY (ARRAY['designer'::text, 'prepress'::text])) AND (role <> ALL (ARRAY['observer'::text, 'approver'::text]))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (public.organization_memberships m
     JOIN public.organization_memberships mine ON ((mine.organization_id = m.organization_id)))
  WHERE ((m.user_id = profiles.id) AND (mine.user_id = public.actor_id())))))

policy:projects:production_project.using:
((public.actor_role() = 'production'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.production_packages pp
  WHERE (pp.project_id = projects.id))))

policy:technical_review_items:read_techn.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.technical_reviews r
  WHERE (r.id = technical_review_items.review_id)))

policy:version_files:read_files.using:
((public.can_version(version_id) AND ((public.actor_role() <> ALL (ARRAY['observer'::text, 'approver'::text])) OR (kind = 'preview'::text))) OR ((public.actor_role() = 'production'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.production_packages p
  WHERE ((p.file_id = version_files.id) AND (p.status = ANY (ARRAY['transferred'::text, 'received'::text])))))))
